integrity: Exact theorem, assumptions and analytical proof are in RESULT.md; verify.py is a standard-library corroborative finite checker. Classical partition formulas are credited; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the two-sided binary subshift with nondecreasing successive positive gaps between consecutive markers. The calculation does not imply results for general S-gap shifts, other forbidden languages, or independent historical priority. Numerical checks are finite and do not prove infinite statements.
title: Partition-growth complexity and periodic-measure rigidity in a monotone-gap subshift
